meta.title: Two bids: award only 6 of the 10 units to B (partial award); approver approves with a remark
gaps: Create or observe the required two-bid state with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; the prepared state supplies only one bid.
Allocate exactly 6 of 10 units to Vendor B and verify that 4 units remain unawarded; no catalog step edits award quantities.
Verify the proposal contains Vendor B's 6 × 90 = 540 allocation and the unawarded quantity.
Sign in as the separate approver, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve the proposal.
Verify the resulting partial-award purchase order quantity and that the event moves to History.
